summary: Simplify the names of the fretboard modes
detail: Current seven: Roots, Chord positions, CAGED triads, CAGED arpeggios, Triad inversions, CAGED pentatonic, CAGED scales. Four start with "CAGED", and the row is 144px tall on a phone. Depends on the outcome of T4 and T5, which may cut the list first.
resolution: Done 2026-09-07. Six one-word names: Roots, Progression, Chords, Triads, Pentatonic, Scales. The tab is already called CAGED practice and the legend already says 'C shape', so the prefix carried nothing. Mode row on a phone: 144px before the T4 merge, 107px after it, 69px now. data-value attributes are unchanged, so no JS depended on the rename; comments, tooltips and the README follow the new names.

summary: Put a play/pause button back in the playback controls section
detail: T10 made the single Play button float, which took it out of the controls list where it used to sit. Add one back there as well, so the transport section reads complete, and keep the floating one. Both need to show the same play/pause state and label, so setPlayLabel() should drive a set of buttons rather than one element.
resolution: Done 2026-09-07. A second Play sits in the transport list; the floating one keeps its own class. setPlayLabel() and the click handler now drive every .play-btn, so both show the same state and either one toggles playback.

summary: CAGED chords single box: option to ghost the rest of the progression
detail: While practising one grip, show where the progression's other chords sit in that same position, drawn fainter, the way Chord positions dims everything but the sounding chord. Optional, via a toggle in the Shapes row. Can reuse what Chord positions already has: ROOT_PALETTE for per-chord colour and the pos-follow / pos-current / pos-next CSS tiers. Note CAGED chords is currently a single-chord view driven by the chord picker, so it would need the other chords' grips computed for the same fret window.
resolution: Done 2026-09-07. An 'Other chords' toggle in the Shapes row draws the progression's remaining chords faintly into the current box, each in its ROOT_PALETTE colour, skipping frets the chord in front already uses, with the legend naming them. It follows the view in front: grips when shape-only, chord tones when Whole arpeggio. Needs Single box on, since it fills one position. Ghosts carry no label - position is the information and the legend says whose - and are excluded from collectShapeRanges so they can't distort a shape's fret span.

summary: Re-order the practice tab: chart, fretboard, key/chord settings, playback settings
detail: Split the chord chart out of the playback-controls panel. New top-to-bottom order: (1) the chord chart on its own at the very top, (2) the fretboard, (3) the key and chord settings, (4) the playback settings. Also add a copy of the 60/90/120 BPM buttons beneath the floating play button, so tempo is reachable without scrolling to the playback settings. Supersedes the T1 arrangement, which put the transport above the chart within one panel.
